ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an animal cell structure, with “Cell coat” marked on the outer edge on the right side, and “Plasma membrane” marked near the adjacent boundary layer on its inner side. The diagram also marks internal structures such as cytoplasm, mitochondria, and Golgi apparatus. Reasoning: The question asks “what is directly inside the cell coat.” Looking from the “Cell coat” label on the right side toward the inside of the cell, the next layer closely adjacent to its inner side is marked “Plasma membrane,” therefore the answer is Plasma membrane.
